findings.summary: Redirect compares an UNRESOLVED project_root, so a relative or symlinked root escapes to the real ledger. invoke()'s documented except path sets root=Path('.') and emit resolves it to cwd.
live_env silently doubles as an AC-001 opt-out; pyproject registers it as an env-pin opt-out only, and the bypass scan cannot see markers.
from harness_maker.codex_ledger import emit binds the real function at import time and is immune to the module-attribute patch; test_second_opinion_ledger.py already uses that idiom.
The mechanism ships unconfigured: the base file is still the legacy map, so 144 slug:'s' + 6 canary rows still enter every aggregate. Phase 1 exit conjunct 2 is unmet on disk.
Dead duplicate EXCLUSIONS_FILE whose comment still documents the retired run-id-map schema, and SPEC + PLAN both route readers to it as the only exclusion reader.
report now filters rows for the first time on this ledger and discloses nothing in its payload; an over-broad entry empties it and is reported as 'no rows — absence of evidence'.
load accepts an entry with no value: missing becomes '' and null becomes the literal 'None', producing an inert predicate with no warning while the neighbouring key check shouts.
excluded_run_ids drops the key and collapses same-value entries, so the sole published audit trail under-reports both the breadth and the count of what was suppressed.
Predicate delegation is asserted at 2 of 3 call sites; marginal_gain can keep a private predicate and pass the whole set.
The invoke canary's status assertion depends on the base repo's harness.yaml, which no fixture pins — an unrelated config edit turns it red.
_restores_the_real_emit has no positive control; assert not offenders is true both when nothing bypasses and when the detector is dead.
load treats every JSON object as a legacy map, so a new-schema file written as one object is silently mis-read; untested.
The redirect forwards **kw untouched, so an absolute observability_dir with a substituted project_root trips emit's containment guard inside an autouse fixture.
The _TESTS_ROOT comment states an 'only when' predicate that omits the None arm, and says 'lands inside this checkout' where the code means 'contains the tests tree'.
The loud branches of load (non-dict entry, top-level scalar) have no test.
